author: voidloop
body:
Hello there Avicus!
Today I was in Math class, thinking about my stuff, and I came up with this brilliant idea.

It would be basically a translator rank that would be added to Teamspeak. Translator ranks could maybe be applied for or just asked for, and could have permissions to join Screenshare rooms and obviously Support rooms(Anyone can join those)(Leaving up to TS Developers.)

I think it would be nice since the screensharing is now implemented on the Avicus Network! It happened to me yesterday, Oscar & Spookz were screensharing a guy, and he was spanish and didn't have any knowledge of English. So I got called in to teamspeak to do as a translator.

Maybe Spanish, Italian and French translators would be a good idea, although, IMO, Spanish should be the most important one.

Opinions?
